name: Automatic Size and Variance Determination for Surface Splatting
definition: A method to improve surface splatting quality on close-up views by automatically computing the radius (size) and variance for each splat to ensure hole-free rendering and smooth blending, comparable to polygon rendering.
summary: Automatic Size and Variance Determination for Surface Splatting is a method that automatically computes per-splat radius and variance based on local point density to ensure hole-free, smooth blending without manual adjustment.
